title: Belrose Promotional Financing Plans — Posting the Financed Purchase to the Plan
content:
# Belrose Promotional Financing Plans — Posting the Financed Purchase to the Plan

**Finance desk ledger note.** The financed merchandise on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan is billed to the plan as one entry per merchandise line on the sales receipt, carrying the receipt reference and the item reference it was sold under.

## Rule

- A purchase is posted to a promotional financing plan only while that plan stands at applied, approved or active. The status is read from the plan record at the time of posting.
- The price of a protection plan is added to the financed balance only on the terms that admit it, as the term schedule states; where the term does not admit it the protection plan is taken on other tender and no entry is booked here.
- Where the sale is later unwound in full, the purchase entries are not deleted but answered by return credits that carry the same receipt and item references.

## Reading the plan's billing history

| Entry | What it carries |
|---|---|
| A purchase entry | The financed amount of one merchandise line, positive, with the sales receipt number and the item reference |
| A return credit answering it | A negative amount carrying the same receipt and item references, so that the purchase entry itself stands unchanged |

A receipt with three merchandise lines financed on one plan produces three purchase entries, one per line, each with its own item reference; a full unwinding of that sale later produces three return credits, each referring to the purchase entry it gives back.
